description: On-axis longitudinal field Bz(z) of the IDEA detector main solenoid and screening solenoid, digitized from an Opera plot "Bz (T) vs Z (m)" with three curves: Main Solenoid Only, Screening Only, Both Energized. One side of the IP, z = 0..6 m. Raw digitization: one point per pixel column (per pixel row in steep parts), not smoothed or resampled.

source.figure: Opera plot, Bz (T) vs Z (m), z = 0..6 m (2 T at z = 0)
source.axis: not stated on the plot; file named "beam_axis" as requested. The 15 mrad tilt between detector and beam axes changes on-axis Bz only at second order in the offset.

flags.visible: centre of the fully visible line
flags.partial: line partly covered by another curve, a gridline or the logo; centre from the visible edge(s) and the line thickness, sigma_Bz includes the ambiguity
flags.hidden_under_screening_only: line fully covered by the red curve; Bz taken from it
flags.hidden_under_both: line fully covered by the black curve; Bz taken from it
flags.under_logo: inside the Opera logo box (z >= 5.735 m): only slivers between the letters are visible; sigma_Bz >= 3 px

notes: Sign: "Screening Only" is plotted positive, but Both = Main - Screening_plotted (rms 5 mT, max 19 mT over z = 0..5.75 m; Main + Screening_plotted is off by 1.7 T rms). The screening solenoid's on-axis field is therefore -Bz of the screening_only curve, assuming linear superposition (the Opera model may contain iron).
Main Solenoid Only is hidden under Screening Only for z ~ 1.9-4.1 m (the curves coincide there within the line width); see the flags.

Gap: the Opera logo box covers z >= 5.735 m. Both Energized and Screening Only end at z = 5.73 m (black curve and black letters cannot be separated; the box darkens the red line); Main Solenoid Only has a few under_logo points up to z = 5.95 m. All three curves are below ~0.01 T there and overlap each other within ~8 px for z > 5.5 m.

Sampling: one point per pixel column, and one per pixel row where the curve is steep (Both: z ~ 1.2-1.6 m; Screening Only: ~1.25-1.6 and ~2.5-3.15 m; Main Solenoid Only: ~2.55-3.1 m). z is non-decreasing but repeats there (several rows share the same column centre); Bz is monotonic within those runs. Interpolate Bz(z) only after merging repeated z, or treat the points as a parametric curve.

Accuracy: 1 px = 3.4 mm in z and 2.2 mT in Bz. Calibration residuals <= 0.7 px. Line thickness ~6 px (~13 mT); visible points are good to ~0.5 px (~1 mT), see sigma_Bz per point. In the steep edge (z ~ 1.3-1.5 m) a 1 px error in z is up to ~30 mT in Bz.

digitization.method: Colour masks per curve (green/red/black); black curve separated from the (black) gridlines by a 3x3 morphological opening; column scan where |dBz/dz| is small, row scan where the curve is steep; occlusion handled by fitting a band of the measured line thickness that covers all visible pixels and extends only into adjacent non-background pixels.
